questions.stem: Luteinizing hormone (LH) and human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) have similar biologic activity for which of the following reasons?
questions.stemHtml: Luteinizing hormone (LH) and human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) have similar biologic activity for which of the following reasons?

options.label: C
options.text: They are produced by the same pituitary cell type

options.label: D
options.text: They are converted to the same amino acid sequence peripheral
